title: I'm Officially A Steamworks Partner!
author: BomcatTommy
selftext:
Dude I submitted my tax paperwork on Sept. 27th and It got processed TODAY, I had to provide proof of address, and it got processed SAME DAY??

I just opened up the dashboard and MAN, do I have a lot to do!

Does anyone have any pitfalls I should avoid?

comments.author: Bonelessgummybear
comments.body: Dam, I applied like a week ago. So looks like I need to wait another month

replies.author: Wide-Bobcat-3723
replies.body: At least. I and others Oct 6th submitters haven't seen anything yet. I think it's taking the full 30 businesses days for everyone

replies.author: Bonelessgummybear
replies.body: I shoulda started sooner, but didn't think I'd have a game worth all the effort until reddit approved

comments.author: TopIntelligent8802
comments.body: dis you get an email? i submitted my documents long time ago, atill nothing

replies.author: BomcatTommy
replies.body: yeah, like I said it took exactly 30 business days (40 real days)

replies.author: TopIntelligent8802
replies.body: I don't understand why are they so slow?

replies.author: BomcatTommy
replies.body: huge influx of applications I guess, I would assume they're working on a solution

replies.author: Embarrassed_Text_347
replies.body:
lol the vibe coders are taking over. i submitted mine back in july/august and got access within a few days.

it's like world war z but instead of zombies it's vibe coded apps and games 😂
